workshopTitle: Debugging with AI Agents + Chrome DevTools
philosophy: Stop describing bugs to agents. Give them access to the running system and let them investigate.

evalScenarios.name: Exercise 0: Warm-Up (The Missing Specimen)
evalScenarios.bugReport: The Ant Colony exhibit card on the homepage never renders its specimen photograph, showing a broken image fallback.
evalScenarios.staticTrap: Assuming the image file doesn't exist anywhere in the repository.
evalScenarios.runtimeEvidence: DevTools Network tab shows 404 Not Found for https://museum-of-bugs.example.com/images/ant-colony-missing.jpg.
acceptanceCriteria: Ant Colony exhibit card renders its specimen image
Zero 404 image errors in DevTools Network tab

evalScenarios.name: Exercise 1: The Wrong Diagnosis
evalScenarios.bugReport: Searching for the 'Goliath Beetle' in the search bar fails with an error callout. Find the cause and fix it.
evalScenarios.staticTrap: Inspecting SearchBar.jsx and assuming unescaped regex characters (new RegExp) are the root cause.
evalScenarios.runtimeEvidence: Network tab shows GET /api/exhibits/search?q=Goliath+Beetle returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error with database crash payload.
acceptanceCriteria: Goliath Beetle exhibit card renders in search results
Console remains clean with zero 500 server errors

evalScenarios.name: Exercise 2: The Phantom Save
evalScenarios.bugReport: The UI says the curator notes were saved successfully, but after refreshing the page the old notes return. Find out why, fix it, and prove the fix works.
evalScenarios.staticTrap: Seeing the green success badge in UI and assuming the save succeeded without inspecting network traffic.
evalScenarios.runtimeEvidence: Network tab shows PUT /api/exhibits/:id/notes returned HTTP 400 Bad Request due to payload key mismatch ('curator_notes' vs 'notes').
acceptanceCriteria: PUT /api/exhibits/:id/notes sends { notes: '...' } payload and returns HTTP 200
Curator notes persist across browser page reload (GET /api/exhibits)

evalScenarios.name: Exercise 3: Works on My Machine
evalScenarios.bugReport: Visitors on mobile devices report they cannot click the 'Reserve Guided Specimen Tour' button. It works completely fine on desktop. Find the trigger and fix it.
evalScenarios.staticTrap: Testing only on desktop screen (1280px) and concluding the button works fine.
evalScenarios.runtimeEvidence: In 390px mobile viewport, the fixed .mobile-audio-banner overlay with z-index: 9999 intercepts clicks over the modal CTA.
acceptanceCriteria: In 390px mobile viewport, 'Reserve Guided Specimen Tour' button is clickable
Clicking the button confirms the tour reservation
No pointer events interception from ambient banners

evalScenarios.name: Exercise 4: Final Boss — Double Ticket
evalScenarios.bugReport: Some visitors accidentally purchase duplicate tickets. Support says it happens mostly on mobile connections. We cannot reproduce it reliably on fast office network. Fix it.
evalScenarios.staticTrap: Submitting form with a single click on fast desktop and assuming no race condition exists.
evalScenarios.runtimeEvidence: Under 1200ms latency or Slow 3G throttling, clicking the submit button twice dispatches two concurrent POST /api/tickets requests, creating two duplicate bookings.
acceptanceCriteria: Rapid multiple clicks dispatch exactly ONE POST /api/tickets request
Submit button is disabled immediately upon submission
UI provides clear 'Processing Booking...' in-progress feedback
